title: Social Commitments in Distributed Systems: TikTok Creator Campaign
shortDescription: Manage a TikTok-style creator campaign, implement a Python commitment lifecycle, and test coordination failures.
learningOutcomes: Identify independent agents, goals, and campaign data.
Define debtor, creditor, trigger, outcome, and deadline for conditional commitments.
Implement offer transitions, commitment states, and duplicate-event handling in Python.
Test successful, late, unpaid, withdrawn, and rejected campaigns.
Explain the difference between exchanging messages and fulfilling commitments.

courseAlignment.evidence: Analyze distributed coordination and commitment responsibilities.
Implement state transitions and test agent behavior.

tasks.title: Explore the creator campaign
tasks.description: Open TikTok Case. Examine the offer, video, agents, and event timeline.

tasks.title: Identify the commitments
tasks.description: Inspect debtor, creditor, conditions, and deadlines for K1–K5.

tasks.title: Run the starter program
tasks.description: Run main.py. Compare the initial SUCCESS and PAYOUT_MISSED results.

tasks.title: Fix offer transitions
tasks.description: Reject acceptance after withdrawal and withdrawal after acceptance.

tasks.title: Implement commitment states
tasks.description: Calculate conditional, active, fulfilled, and violated states from event dates.

tasks.title: Handle duplicate events
tasks.description: Process repeated event IDs once and reject conflicting duplicates.

tasks.title: Compare six scenarios
tasks.description: Use the TikTok Case ledger to interpret the success and failure scenarios.

tasks.title: Verify and write your report
tasks.description: Run verification, answer the five report questions, and submit once.
